title: Ask Suggest Priority Batching
desc: Triage wkappbot suggest backlogs. OVERRIDE (2026-06-06): 'ask gpt' is DISABLED -- chronic CDP/ChatGPT-session-expiry loop makes it unreliable. Use wkhippo foresee (predecessor outcomes) + wkcodex (API-based, no browser) for ranking and per-item triage instead. The GPT-ranking steps below are SUSPENDED until ask-health-check confirms a stable PONG.
steps: Batch triage: one GPT ranking pass for full page, then per-item queries fired concurrently. next:ask-suggest-priority-batching-howto for execution steps. cluster:ask-suggest-priority-batching-ref for calibration history.
DELEGATION PATTERN: Sonnet fires queries and waits. After responses arrive, brief Opus with ts+title+result+fix-path. Opus edits/builds/resolves. Sonnet never writes code inline.
TIMEOUT=20s (--timeout 20s). No response in 20s = proceed with codebase analysis immediately. Never block indefinitely. No retry.
STOP after firing queries. Do NOT use Sonnet tokens while GPT runs. Resume only after responses or 20s timeout. This is the whole point of batching.

[RECALL BEFORE ASK -- wkhippo first] Before firing 'ask gpt' for a per-item suggest triage question (root cause? fix path?), FIRST run 'wkhippo foresee <symptom/ts/error-keywords>' -- a predecessor session has very often already triaged or fixed the exact same BUG-AUTO/symptom, and foresee returns its outcome-ranked record (the fix that worked + the commands run, or the approach that broke). This is local, pace-exempt, and has no CDP/ChatGPT dependency, so it works even when the ask pipeline is down. Use ask gpt ONLY for genuinely novel items the corpus has no precedent for. Saves a CDP round-trip and avoids re-deriving a known fix. See [[hippocampus-living-memory-howto]] and [[ask-health-check]] (wkhippo local-fallback step). //why:consult predecessor outcomes before novel triage
PIPELINE HEALTH CHECK: ping --new-session --sync --timeout 20s before triage. Broken pipeline = file BUG-AUTO + continue with codebase analysis fallback.

[OVERRIDE -- READ FIRST] ask gpt is DISABLED for triage as of 2026-06-06 (chronic CDP / ChatGPT-session-expiry loop -- it keeps cycling broken). IGNORE every step below that says 'fire ask gpt' / 'GPT ranking pass' / 'ask gpt per item'. INSTEAD: (1) rank + per-item triage with 'wkhippo foresee <ts/symptom/error-kw>' to find the predecessor that already solved it (outcome-ranked, local, pace-exempt, no browser); (2) for novel items with no precedent ([FRONTIER]), delegate to wkcodex (GPT-5.5 via API -- no CDP dependency). Re-enable the GPT steps ONLY after ask-health-check confirms a stable PONG. See hippocampus-living-memory-howto.

Cross-link: wksplit-400-lock auto-register coverage check (2026-06-25) -- the coverage pre-check in wkharness-*-post.ps1 skips appending duplicate harness:skill blocks when the file is already covered by an existing wildcard rule.

BATCH BY ROOT CAUSE, NOT BY INCIDENT -- one class with SEVEN instances outranks seven separate entries. WHEN: a session accumulates several guard refusals or tool failures in one sitting and is deciding what to file. HOW: before writing any entry, group the refusals by the PREDICATE that produced them, not by the command that tripped them; file ONE entry per predicate carrying every instance as evidence, and rank it by instance count. WHY: measured 2026-09-13 in wkappbot-kih. Seven refusals looked like seven guards -- anti-knowledge versus heart-v2 over a redirect, a heredoc BODY read as an invocation, a brief PROHIBITION read as a request, two brief gates whose prescribed remedies refuse each other, a brief DESCRIBING a guard refused by that same guard, a bug-fix brief asked for a wired proto, and a heredoc commit message refused as unparseable. All seven share ONE predicate defect: a classifier matching characters inside a quoted payload, a diff context line or a negation, and treating them as the author's instruction. Filed as seven each reads as a minor annoyance and none gets priority; filed as one with seven instances it is the highest-value entry of the day. THE TELL that a group is really one class: every remedy you can think of is the same remedy. Cross: wkappbot skill read gate-two-tier-verify-before-block-t1 for the confirm-before-refuse pattern this class needs. //why:triage grouped suggests by root cause correctly //why:root cause batching prevents duplicate fix work

POLICY REMINDER (user directive, cross-linked from suggest-workflow step 12): triaging/resolving a suggest means aligning the fix with the CURRENT system policy and development direction -- never blindly implement the suggester's literal ask. Apply engineering judgment before landing any fix. Full policy: wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow (step 12).
